thread:
maya: Quick sync — we have RadialEcho ready for a short customer story + a live webinar mention. Need: interview slot, final quote approval from legal, and confirm lead routing for webinar attendees. <https://drive.redwood.com/radial-echo-brief|brief here>

samir: Happy to do interview. Samir (CS) available Mon/Tue mornings PST. prefer 30m.

lucy: Producer here — can do Tue 10am PT or Wed 9am PT. I can handle recording and transcript. Will we want a short 2–3 minute promo clip?

maya: Yes promo clip would be great. Samir if you can do Tue 10am PT that lines up with Lucy. @elaine-legal — we need signoff on the customer quote + release. Sending the quoted lines below.

samir: Tue 10 works for me.

kyle-sales: Quick Q on lead routing: can we funnel webinar signups into SDR queue for RadialEcho interested list? Need UTM & form field to map product interest.

maya: @kyle-sales yes — routing to SDR pool RadialEcho_Interest. We'll add field 'primary_use_case' and utm_campaign=radial-echo-launch. Can you confirm Salesforce queue name?

kyle-sales: SF queue = SDR_RadialEcho; will add automation to create Lead with tag "radial_echo_webinar".

elaine-legal: I glanced at the quote. Two notes: 1) customer needs an opt-in consent line for publication, 2) avoid forward-looking claims. Please paste the final quote and the consent paragraph.

maya: Pasted quote + consent below:

```
"RadialEcho's integration cut inference costs by ~45% and reduced p95 latency from 800ms to 220ms on production traffic." — RadialEcho CTO

Consent: "By approving this quote, RadialEcho grants Redwood Inference permission to publish the quote and associated case study materials (transcript, short promo clips) for marketing and sales purposes."
```

lucy: Tiny edit suggestion — change "production traffic" to "our production workload" to avoid ambiguity. Also can you ask for a short 1–2 sentence executive quote they can approve? Usually easier for legal.

samir: I'll ask them for a brief 1–2 sentence line and the consent.

elaine-legal: If they return the short quote, send it to me. I'll run it through the template. Also confirm: do we need a separate data-processing addendum? If RadialEcho supplied logs, yes.

maya: They provided aggregated metrics only, no raw logs. We should be fine but I'll confirm.

redwood-bot: Reminder: legal review request should be submitted via /legal-review and include the consent text + final quote. Target SLA 48h.

maya: Action items:
- Samir: collect 1–2 sentence exec quote + explicit consent (due EOD Fri)
- Lucy: block Tue 10am PT for recording, prepare short promo script and transcript workflow
- Kyle: wire up SDR_RadialEcho queue & confirm form fields (utm_campaign + primary_use_case)
- Elaine: legal to review once quote + consent submitted (48h SLA)

tony: For the launch post and webinar narrative, propose we lead with the cost/latency win, include a short benchmark snippet (3 lines) and a CTA to the webinar signup. I'll draft messaging if everyone ok with the final quote.

maya: Sounds good — Tony pls draft initial copy and share in thread. I'll loop in RadialEcho contact once Samir has the quote. :thumbsup:

samir: Reached out to RadialEcho. They'll get back by EOD with the short quote and consent.

lucy: Confirming recording logistics — I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + Otter transcript and ask for permission to record.

elaine-legal: Thanks. Once I have the short quote I'll respond here with any redlines.

maya: Great team — keeping this tight. If legal signoff comes back clean we aim to publish the case page + launch post the week after next and slot the webinar within 2 weeks of publish.

redwood-bot: Added reminder: /task create "RadialEcho case study — legal review" assigned to elaine-legal due 48h.
